init.title: ESP32 CC1101 RF Studio
init.description:
### ESP32 CC1101 RF Control Center
{status_msg}Select a category to manage your remotes, transfer data, or tune radio settings.

manage_devices.title: RF Devices & Remotes
manage_devices.description: Select an existing device from the list to manage its buttons or type a new device name directly.

device_menu.title: Device: {device_name}

device_manage_buttons.title: Buttons for {device_name}
device_manage_buttons.description: {status_msg}Select the button you wish to view, test or edit:

button_edit_menu.title: Edit Button: {button_name}

button_rename.title: Rename Button: {button_name}
button_rename.description: Enter the new name for this button in '{device_name}':

button_move.title: Move Button: {button_name}
button_move.description: Select or type the destination device you want to transfer '{button_name}' to:

button_repeats.title: Transmit Repeats: {button_name}
button_repeats.description: Configure how many burst repetitions will be transmitted when '{button_name}' is pressed:

button_delete.title: Delete Button: {button_name}
button_delete.description: Are you sure you want to permanently delete the button '{button_name}' from '{device_name}'?

device_edit_device.title: Edit Device: {device_name}
device_edit_device.description: Manage device '{device_name}' (registered buttons: {button_count}). Select an option:

device_rename.title: Rename Device: {device_name}
device_rename.description: Enter the new name for this device. All of its buttons and its sensor will be updated automatically:

device_delete.title: Delete Device: {device_name}
device_delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete '{device_name}' and all of its learned buttons from Home Assistant?

device_learn_button.title: Learn RF Button: {device_name}
device_learn_button.description: Step 1 of 2: Enter the button name, transmit repetitions, and recording signal power filter:

device_learn_record.title: Record Button: {button_name}
device_learn_record.description:
You are about to record the button '{button_name}' for '{device_name}'.

Active power filter: `{learn_rssi} dBm` (only strong nearby signals accepted; normal sensitivity will be restored automatically when done).

Instructions:
1. Hold remote 10–30 cm from CC1101 transceiver.
2. Click Submit below to begin.
3. As soon as you click Submit, press and hold the button on your physical remote continuously for 5 seconds.

device_learn_failed.title: Recording Failed: {button_name}
device_learn_failed.description:
No consistent, stable signal was detected.

Reason: {error_reason} ({sample_count} bursts received).
Current power filter: {learn_rssi} dBm.

What would you like to do?

device_learn_tune_rssi.title: Tune Power Filter: {button_name}
device_learn_tune_rssi.description: Configure the signal power filter (RSSI) exclusively for recording this button. Higher values (e.g. -50 dBm or -40 dBm) strictly limit recording to strong signals held right next to the antenna, ignoring noise or distant remotes:

device_learn_verify.title: Test Remote Detection: {button_name}
device_learn_verify.description:
Button is already successfully saved ({candidate_desc}).

If you want to test physical remote detection in real time:
1. Click Submit below.
2. Press the remote button ONCE (you have 12 seconds).

device_learn_verify_failed.title: Detection Not Received: {button_name}
device_learn_verify_failed.description:
No button press was detected within the time limit.

The button '{button_name}' remains saved with the confirmed 5-second signal ({candidate_desc}).

What would you like to do now?

menu_options.device_test_send: Test RF Transmit from Home Assistant
menu_options.device_learn_button: Learn another button for this device
menu_options.device_menu: Finish and return to device menu

device_test_send.title: Test RF Transmit: {button_name}
device_test_send.description:

device_learn_success.description:
